algolia.name: Samsung - NX500 Mirrorless Camera with 16-50mm Lens - Brown
algolia.description: With a 28.2-megapixel BSI CMOS sensor and a 16-50mm lens, this Samsung NX500 mirrorless camera makes it easy to capture high-definition footage and clear photos in a variety of scenarios. Built-in Wi-Fi simplifies wireless image transfer.  Memory card sold separately.
